correctness.rationale: For rank-one \(P\) and \(Q=U^*PU\), \(Q=P\) gives zero. If \(Q\ne P\), then \(c=\operatorname{Tr}(PQ)<1\), and the \(Q\)-versus-\(I-Q\) measurement sends \((P,Q)\) to \(((c,1-c),(1,0))\); the classical relative entropy is \(+\infty\). Data processing for maximal \(f\)-divergence therefore forces the quantum value to \(+\infty\). This proves the exact two-point orbit image and directly contradicts the source interval statement.

value.rationale: The source presents interval-valued orbit range as a main consequence and repeats it in the abstract. The counterexample shows that this conclusion fails maximally on pure states: a connected orbit maps to only two extended values \(0\) and \(+\infty\). This isolates the boundary-continuity failure and identifies a clean faithful-state repair without overclaiming about the endpoint formulas.
